title: Nutrients and Food Tests
summary: Carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, fibre and water, and how to test foods for starch, protein and fat.

ib.note: Biochemical tests (Benedict's, biuret) are named in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 3: Mindful Eating: A Path to a Healthy Body

objectives: I can name the main nutrients and their functions.
I can carry out tests for starch, protein and fat and interpret the results.
I can identify good food sources of each nutrient.
misconceptions: Fats are always bad for you.
Fibre is useless because we can’t digest it.
